sample_unit: clinicians rating ChatGPT responses to 16 Alzheimer's disease myths

links.outcome: Clinician-rated agreement with accuracy of ChatGPT explanations of Alzheimer's myths
links.effect: Clinicians (n=10) were generally satisfied; mean (SD) score 1.1 (±0.3) on -2 to 2 Likert scale across 16 myths; no 'Strongly Disagree' responses.
links.quote: Among the 16 myths, the clinicians were generally satisfied with these explanations, with [mean (SD) score of 1.1(±0.3)].

screen.reason: The study evaluates ChatGPT's ability to refute Alzheimer's disease myths via expert clinician ratings of its responses, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or operational practice.
